   211→    def _replace_string_params(
   212→        self,
   213→        s: str,
   214→        params: Mapping[str, Any],

   218→            return (True, s)

   223→                if sys.version_info.major == 3 and sys.version_info.minor > 8:

   225→                        hashlib.md5(
   226→                            json.dumps(v).encode("utf-8"), usedforsecurity=False
   227→                        )
   228→                        .digest()
   229→                        .hex()[0:4]
   230→                    )
   231→                else:
   232→                    v = hashlib.md5(json.dumps(v).encode("utf-8")).digest().hex()[0:4]

   237→            new_s = str_node(new_s, s.start_mark, s.end_mark)
   238→
   239→        return (not (bool(re.search(pattern, new_s))), new_s)
